reason: A Yunzhijia integration bundle for DeepSeek Harness that exposes CLI-backed collaboration, document, data, messaging, file, task, calendar, memory, and workflow capabilities through tools and a browser workspace.

summaries.zh: 将云之家 CLI 与协作、文档、表格、日程、消息、文件、待办、推进和本地记忆能力集成到 DeepSeek Harness，并提供配套工作台。
summaries.en: Integrates Yunzhijia CLI-backed collaboration, documents, sheets, calendars, messaging, files, tasks, advancement, and local memory into DeepSeek Harness with a companion workspace.

capabilities: Connects to Yunzhijia through yzj-cli and WebSocket or HTTP channels
Reads and writes Yunzhijia documents, sheets, calendars, contacts, messages, files, todos, and advancement records
Provides a browser workspace panel for conversations, tasks, calendars, knowledge, and advancement
Stores scoped Markdown memory locally and can inject bounded context into prompts
Supports scheduled unattended routines and message delivery
Uses confirmation flows for agent-initiated write operations
